Two things share one FastAPI process in `app.py`. The persona must keep running even if the agent fails; every hook into the agent is wrapped so an import or startup failure degrades to plain fleet monitoring.

Persona / fleet monitor. `eyes.py` polls Prometheus and Uptime Kuma. `brain.py` speaks in character through `llm.py` (the one LLM client both halves use). `voice.py` is Telegram; `speech.py` is hold-to-talk and spoken replies. `hands.py` is the only actuator (Home Assistant lights). `config.py` and `configfile.py` load non-secret config; secrets come from the environment.

Research agent (`skynet/agent/`). `loop.py` runs the unattended cycle. The ingest path is `frontier` to `web`/`ingest` (with `guards`, `politeness`, `licensing`, `storage`) to `rawstore` to `scanner`/`fence`/`chunker` to `extractor`. Only the quarantined side sees raw page text. `planner` never does. Claims then pass through `relevance`, `entries`, `dedup`, and `works` into `kb` (Postgres via `memory`; `conflicts` is the contradiction court), then `corroborate`, then the read path `embed`/`retrieve`. `wiki` writes library pages. `api`, `wiki_api`, and `mcp_server` are the fenced read surfaces. `converse` and `requests` are the HUD seams.

Two halves share one FastAPI process (app.py). The fleet monitor is the box's job; the research agent is additive and wrapped, so a failure never takes the service down.

Monitor: eyes polls Prometheus and Uptime Kuma. brain speaks in character through llm. voice sends lines out. speech is hold-to-talk and TTS. hands is the only actuator (Home Assistant lights). config and configfile load settings.

Agent, started by app only if enabled: loop runs the cycle. frontier picks the next URL. web and ingest fetch, store, scan, chunk, and fence pages. extractor (quarantined, with adjudicate) pulls claims. relevance, entries, dedup, and works gate them. kb writes through memory (Postgres). conflicts and corroborate re-read contradictions and link facts. embed and retrieve serve search; wiki writes cited pages. api, wiki_api, mcp_server, and converse_api are the read surfaces. planner decides and never sees page text. guards, politeness, licensing, and storage sit under every fetch.
